trigger_summaries.mna.target.*: was named as the target of an acquisition approach
trigger_summaries.mna.target.*|rumored: was reported, without confirmation, as an acquisition target
trigger_summaries.mna.target.*|denied: was reported as an acquisition target and the report has since been denied
trigger_summaries.mna.acquirer.*: was named as the acquirer in an acquisition approach
trigger_summaries.mna.acquirer.*|rumored: was reported, without confirmation, as a prospective acquirer
trigger_summaries.regulatory_action.subject.adverse: was named in an adverse regulatory action
trigger_summaries.listing.subject.*: was announced for listing on a new venue
trigger_summaries.listing.subject.*|rumored: was reported, without confirmation, as a candidate for listing on a new venue
trigger_summaries.delisting.subject.*: was announced for removal from a venue
trigger_summaries.hack_exploit.subject.*: was reported to have suffered an exploit or breach

falsifiers.earnings_surprise: a restatement, a one-off item that explains the surprise, or a guidance revision in the opposite direction
falsifiers.guidance_change: management walking the revision back, or a segment disclosure that contradicts it
falsifiers.mna: a formal denial by either party, a competing approach, or a regulatory block
falsifiers.regulatory_action: an appeal, a stay of the order, or a settlement on materially different terms
falsifiers.listing: the venue postponing or reversing the listing, or trading opening with very thin depth
falsifiers.delisting: the venue reinstating the pair, or a migration path that preserves access
falsifiers.hack_exploit: recovery of the funds, a credible reimbursement plan, or the loss proving smaller than first reported

already_priced_note: Most of the announcement move was already in the price before the first bar this signal can be measured from; the band above covers only what came after that point.
